_comment: The 16 screen presets from the research contract (brief section 13). implementation_status is 'wired' when a real ranking function exists and is reachable from the UI/pipeline today, and 'specification_only' when this entry documents the intended ranking/filter/risk-control rules but nothing computes them yet. Never claim 'wired' without a real, tested implementation cited in 'implemented_in'.

deep_value.name: Deep Value
deep_value.rebalance: matches the refresh cadence (see research_contract.json execution_assumptions)
deep_value.implemented_in: pipeline/sleeves/value.py (score_value_sleeve) -- ranking signals present; hard filters (distress, interest coverage floor) not yet gated at the sleeve level, only scored as evidence

quality_value.name: Quality Value
quality_value.sort: combined value + quality sleeve score, descending

emerging_momentum.name: Emerging Momentum
emerging_momentum.note: Close in spirit to rankEmergingGrowth (src/lib/researchScreens.js) but not the same screen -- that one gates on revenue growth + relative strength, not momentum inflection specifically. No dedicated implementation exists yet.

oversold_reversal.name: Oversold Reversal
oversold_reversal.implemented_in: src/lib/researchScreens.js rankReversal() -- earnings-event context and fundamental-deterioration distinction are not yet separately flagged, only a fundamentals floor gate

high_quality_recovery.name: High-Quality Recovery
high_quality_recovery.note: No long-term (36-60mo) reversal screen exists in this codebase. rankValueTurnarounds (researchScreens.js) is short-horizon (52-week proximity), not this.

mean_reversion_setup.name: Mean-Reversion Setup
mean_reversion_setup.note: pipeline/technical_indicators.py's bollinger_percent_b and relative_strength_index (Phase 6) are real, tested primitives this preset could be built from, but no ranking function combines them into this specific screen yet.

durable_growth.name: Durable Growth
durable_growth.implemented_in: pipeline/sleeves/growth.py -- dilution/cash-burn risk controls not yet gated, only scored as evidence via capital_allocation metrics in the quality sleeve

garp.name: GARP
garp.note: The three component sleeves (value, quality, growth) all exist and are independently testable (pipeline/sleeves/); no combining function at the brief's stated 35/30/25/10 weights has been written yet.

shareholder_yield.name: Shareholder Yield
shareholder_yield.note: net_buyback_yield is a real, scored quality-sleeve metric; dividend_yield exists on published rows (advisor.json) but no combined shareholder-yield ranking function exists.

defensive_compounders.name: Defensive Compounders
defensive_compounders.note: quality sleeve covers profitability; low_beta exists in market_behavior.weights but currently blends into ranking (see feature_registry.json classification_gap on low_beta) rather than serving purely as risk input here.

trend_following.name: Trend Following
trend_following.note: pipeline/technical_indicators.py's moving_average_slope (Phase 6) is a real primitive; moving-average ordering and trend R-squared are not computed anywhere.

earnings_revision_leaders.name: Earnings Revision Leaders
earnings_revision_leaders.rebalance: matches the refresh cadence (see research_contract.json execution_assumptions)
earnings_revision_leaders.implemented_in: pipeline/swing_signals.py swing_scores() + pipeline/build_swing_screen.py -> public/data/screens/swing.json, surfaced at /screens/swing and as the 'swing' ranking model in src/lib/rankingModels.js
earnings_revision_leaders.note: The revision legs (breadth, magnitude, net upgrades, target change) resolve for nearly the whole scored universe. The post-earnings-drift leg is implemented and weighted highest but only scores rows where an earnings surprise resolved and its drift window is still open -- the published file reports that coverage per leg in leg_coverage. There is still no separate guidance factor; guidance reaches the score only through the catalyst family elsewhere.

insider_cluster_buying.name: Insider Cluster Buying
insider_cluster_buying.implemented_in: pipeline/insider_signal.py -- routine vs opportunistic split, SEC Form 4 source-of-record; feeds a bounded score modifier (settings.json modifiers), not yet a standalone ranked screen page

balanced_multi_factor.name: Balanced Multi-Factor
balanced_multi_factor.note: value.py and quality.py sleeves exist; momentum sleeve and catalyst sleeve (as standalone modules matching the sleeve interface) have not been built, only their underlying factor tables (research_screens_v2.py). No combining function exists.
